experiment: IDSIA native receipt-clock angular-rate prediction, version 1

native_import.clock: ROS recorder receipt time; integer nanoseconds converted relative to per-run origin
native_import.source_body_frame: FLU, following documented Crazyflie convention; logger mounting/version not independently confirmed

selection_policy: First real-data experiment: fixed architecture/horizon; early stopping on normalized validation MSE. Compare persistence, ridge and NN on validation. Freeze before one final test; no test-driven tuning.
limitations: All recordings from one aircraft and date; manoeuvre families separated across splits: square train, chirp validation, random test
Test uses unseen random manoeuvre recordings, not the paper's Melon split
Forecast concerns observed telemetry arrival clock, not independently verified sensor acquisition timing
Logged thrust channels are normalized commands, not measured RPM or proven applied ESC duty
No sensor-health guarantee from finite/range/flying flags
